name: Carol Haney

five_sec.what_is_it: That's eMeals. That's the one that charged me.
five_sec.trust_why: I cancelled it in the app and they charged me anyhow, and I never got a person on the phone.
five_sec.next_step: I'd close it. My daughter can look if she wants.
five_sec.delivers_food_why: It's the menu thing with the grocery list. I know, I had it.

full_page.what_stopped_me: 'Try Free for 14 Days.' 'No commitment. Cancel anytime.' I've heard that before. There's no telephone number, just 'Need Help?'

EM.quote: 'No commitment. Cancel anytime.' That's what they told me the first time, and I cancelled and they charged me anyhow.

five_sec.what_is_it: A recipe app. Recipes and grocery lists.
five_sec.who_for: Younger folks who are organized on their phones.
five_sec.trust_why: Right there in big letters it says 'no card required'. I like that.
five_sec.next_step: Call my daughter to read the rest.
five_sec.delivers_food_why: Lady writing in a notebook. No boxes.

full_page.what_stopped_me: I'd have to put all my own recipes in it. That's too much fooling with the phone. And after two weeks it's $5.95.
full_page.whats_missing: Somebody to call. Suppers already picked out for me.

PTE.quote: It does say 'no card required' right up top, and I appreciate that. But I'd have to type in all my own recipes. I'm not doing that.

five_sec.what_is_it: I'm not sure. Something on a phone that picks food.
five_sec.trust_why: The big orange button says 'Letter from the CEO'. I don't know why I'd want that.
five_sec.delivers_food_why: Pictures of a rice dish and pancakes on a phone, and messages saying 'I've picked out meals for you'. Might bring it, might not.

full_page.what_stopped_me: Too much going on. The computer makes up the recipes, it says. And $25 a month.

OL.quote: I pushed the big orange button and it's a letter from somebody. I just wanted to know what to fix for supper.

five_sec.trust_why: Little green boxes wanting me to pick one for a prize. That's how they get you.
five_sec.delivers_food_why: The boxes say HelloFresh on them.

full_page.what_stopped_me: The tiny print at the bottom says 'auto-renewing'. And it won't say a price till you give your zip code.
full_page.whats_missing: A price and a phone number.

HF.quote: Open a box? Little green boxes jumping at me, and the small print says auto-renewing. No ma'am.

five_sec.what_is_it: It plans supper for the week and puts the list in your Walmart. I think.
five_sec.who_for: Families. It says it texts everybody in the house.
five_sec.trust_why: It says 'no card needed' on the green button. But 'Start free' always makes me nervous.
five_sec.next_step: Send it to my daughter to read the small print.
five_sec.delivers_food_why: It says in green, 'We don't deliver food.' Good. I just want the list in my Walmart pickup.

full_page.what_stopped_me: It says free forever and free for 14 days, both. I don't understand what the 14 days is. And there's no phone number, just an email for Sarah on one page.
full_page.whats_missing: A phone number. Heart-healthy suppers up front (I only saw it as a little link at the very bottom).

DD.quote: It says 'nothing can be charged' because there's no card. I read it twice. I'd still want a phone number to call somebody.

dd_offer.why: Free forever, then Family free for 14 days, then $4.99. That's three things. I don't know which one I'd be on.
dd_offer.expect_day_15: I reckon on day 15 they want the $4.99 or it quits working.

head_to_head.reason: It's the only one that says plain they don't take a card and can't charge me, and it works with my Walmart pickup.

EM.reason: eMeals charged me after I cancelled. DinnerDrop doesn't ask for a card.

PTE.reason: Both say no card, but DinnerDrop picks the suppers so I don't have to type recipes in.

OL.reason: I could at least understand what DinnerDrop does.

dd_fix_that_would_move_me: Home page, right under the green 'Start free, no card needed' button: one plain sentence, 'On day 15 you simply go back to the free plan. We don't have your card, so we can't charge you,' plus a phone number or 'reply to any email and Sarah answers'.
